text:
kai: flagging a regression risk: coalescer batches break authz semantics if we mix contexts. need to pick an interface boundary.

tess: can you give an example?

kai: renderer emits 12 cell reads for same user but different entities. coalescer combines into one backend call. central PDP can decide in bulk, but mixing tenants/users is disallowed.

li: options: 1) pre-check each item before batching (more PDP qps), 2) batch then post-filter results (couples backend to policy model), 3) token-per-batch where PDP returns a signed intent token the backend can apply.

priya: security constraint: cannot leak ids across tenants. coalescer must at least group by tenant.

jun: token approach: PDP returns compact token (policy_version + bitmask or predicate) signed with short TTL. backend validates signature. revocation handled via version mismatch.

tess: perf worry: token generation adds latency. where to run PDP? sidecar seems closest to coalescer.

kai: experimental plan: run three patterns (pre-check, enriched-batch-key, token) against synthetic dashboards and compare batching efficiency, authz_qps, and end-to-end render p95. SLOs: render_p95 < 120ms, authz_p95 < 12ms.

li: I will simulate three traffic shapes: dense single-tenant, mixed-tenant, tenant-heavy. will report batch_size_dist, coalesce_rate, authz_p95/p99.

priya: need correctness tests for leakage and audit hooks. token should carry evaluation_id for logging.

jun: infra notes: token signer needs key rotation; reuse KMS and short-lived keys.

infra-bot: ci: coalescer branch built rwd/coalescer:sha256:ef12dead. token-signer PoC pushed rwd/pdptoken-signer:sha256:beefc0de.

tess: rollout sketch: lab prototyping -> staging A/B at 5k rps -> pilot non-customer dashboards 2% -> ramp with metric gates. rollback if regressions >5%.

kai: agreed. li will run sims this week and reconvene. I9ll update the design doc with token + enriched-key alternatives.
